- From initial inspection : Basic - Wall soiled with accumulated grease, food debris. Cook line - From follow-up inspection 2025-09-19:

Fan covers in the walk in cooler heavily soiled with dust.

Spray hose at dish sink lower than flood rim of sink.
Stop Sale issued on time/temperature control for safety food due to temperature abuse.

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit. At the time of inspection no documentation noted on temperatures to determine how long the food was in the danger zone.
Steam cooler cooked shrimp (52F - Cold Holding); cooked sausage (52F - Cold Holding); boiled eggs (52F - Cold Holding); raw chicken 66F cold hold.
Walk in cooler cooked shrimp (47F - Cold Holding); mahi (48F - Cold Holding); raw shrimp (47F - Cold Holding); cooked rice (46F - Cold Holding); crab legs (47F - Cold Holding); raw shell oysters (50F - Cold Holding); milk (48F - Cold Holding); raw beef patties (49F - Cold Holding); cooked chicken wings (48F - Cold Holding); corn on the cob (47F - Cold Holding) raw shell eggs ambient 50F cold hold

Time/temperature control for safety food, other than whole meat roast, hot held at less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit. soup (112F - Hot Holding); lobster bisque (120F - Hot Holding) rechecked soups found at 165F
Can opener blade soiled.

No soap provided at handwash sink.
Sink in kitchen
No tag on/for original container of raw, in-shell oysters. Found

Bowl or other container with no handle used to dispense food.
Bowl and cup used to scoop rice and spices
Commercially processed reduced oxygen packaged fish bearing a label indicating that it is to remain frozen until time of use no longer frozen and not removed from reduced oxygen package.

Frying oil
